entry.name: mc.cross~
entry.description: Use the cross~ object as a pair of symmetrical low+high pass 3rd order filters with lowpass and highpass outlets you can use separately or in combination to form a crossover filter.

arguments.name: cutoff-frequency
arguments.description: Obligatory. The argument sets the initial cutoff frequency for the lowpass and the highpass parts of the output signal.
